lines.speaker: recruiter_sana
lines.text: Four kilometres of concrete and a patrol every twenty minutes. Don't run. Running is what they're paid to notice.

lines.speaker: recruiter_sana
lines.text: I walk this road picking people up. Not for the militia, whatever the patrol writes down. For a list of who's still standing when the water comes.

lines.speaker: recruiter_sana
lines.text: You've been to the other side of that, haven't you. Don't tell me if it's bad. Tell me if there's anyone left.

choices.text: There are people on the roofs. They held.
Eighty-four years. Be honest with them about it.

lines.speaker: recruiter_sana
lines.text: I've a swimming line up between two chimneys and eleven children on it. You gave me that. I'd like to know it was worth the rope.

lines.speaker: recruiter_sana
lines.text: I stopped walking the road. You can't recruit people to a year. I tell them the date now and they go home and sit with it.
